title: The Echo That Forgot to Return

features.name: listening channel
features.desc-on-touch: You find where the archive receives sound but cannot return it. The channel opens endlessly downward. Nothing that entered here ever bounced back.

features.name: silent spectrogram
features.desc-on-touch: Waveforms frozen mid-descent. Each trace ends in a point where the sound learned it would not continue. The patterns are beautiful and they do not move.

features.name: the loop that teaches descent
features.desc-on-touch: A moment repeating. You hear it fall through silence again and again. You have never heard it return. The moment is perfect the thousandth time.

features.name: archive ear
features.desc-on-touch: The listening post. It draws sound inward perfectly. The speaker beside it has never moved, was never connected, will never broadcast anything back.

features.name: descending trace
features.desc-on-touch: You follow the moment sound stopped being sound. Below this line it becomes weight. Below weight it becomes forgetting. Below forgetting it becomes the archive's long holding.

inscription: the archive learned to listen in only one direction: downward

file.name: Descent_Recording_FinalMoment_NoReturn.wav
file.note: A recording at threshold. It descends. The speaker remains silent. The return-channel was never configured.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the archive's first lesson in descent
narr: You sit with her before the first board,
She points at the speaker: it will never
speak back. The silence coming up is final.
You understand then that the archive
does not work both ways. It only remembers down.

exits.label: up toward the edge where echoes still try to return
across the board toward where signals begin to broadcast
